scope: Every exported TTE field reviewed against the archived original selected sources. Separate own TT/RC/BE path; foreign CAN retry/MTU/rate defaults removed.
Device-specific controller2016 versus PMC rates/interface/channel/VL/COM-port limits. Lowest documented product rate only a conditional proposal, not a universal protocol minimum.

Actual TT integration/cluster/perhop intervals, relative clock precision, SM/CM/SC membership, PCF delay and permanence relationships. Startup/fault assumptions require actual evidence; no invented topology, clock or schedule.

Rate-constrained path uses independently qualified BAG/jitter/queue; best effort has no bound without extra evidence. Whole wire serialization and whole path bounds separate node/application deadline/freshness acceptance.
All exported field type tests plus hardware limits, conditional proposals, schedule, permanence, clock, class-specific and acceptance regressions passed.
763 isolated tests PASS, 146 native andnine shared suites.
